tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults; the CSP screen returned 20 setups. One sells tonight (BSP), three are on watch, 16 pass.
Three uptrends in 20 (BSP, SLS, NAVN), 10 downtrends, 7 mixed. 16 of the 18 with 200-day history trade under their 200 SMA; BSP and FRVO don't have one yet.
17 of 20 are down on the week. 13 of 20 have strikes already under their 60-day lows: when the strike is under the floor, the floor is still being dug.
IV rank (CBOE, 52-week) came through on 11 of 20: 6 rich, 4 mid, 1 near its annual low. Quotes: 13 firm, 7 wide. No earnings date came through from the screen for any of the 20.
Four correlation clusters, all one trade on risk-off tech: MARA+WULF+CORZ+RIOT, NVTS+ALGM, IONQ+OKLO+LUNR+RKLB, PENG+HPE+SMCI.
Gamma scan: 17 of 25 names in positive gamma, 8 negative (last night 18 and 7).
